content.text: {"abstained": false, "abstention_reason": "", "answer": "Mission Shakti is a comprehensive scheme with two sub-schemes: 'Sambal' for safety and security of women, and 'Samarthya' for empowerment of women [E02]. The Sambal sub-scheme includes One Stop Centre (OSC), Women Helpline (WHL), BetiBachaoBetiPadhao (BBBP), and Nari Adalat - women collective [E02]. The Samarthya sub-scheme includes Ujjwala, SwadharGreh, Working Women Hostel, National Creche Scheme, and PMMVY, plus a new component of Gap Funding for Economic Empowerment [E02]. The objective is to provide women and girls, including differently-abled and marginalized groups, with short-term and long-term services for holistic development and empowerment, including immediate care for violence victims, quality rescue and rehabilitation mechanisms, improved accessibility to government services, awareness about schemes and legal provisions, and capacity building of functionaries [E02].", "cited_evidence_ids": ["E02"], "claim_to_evidence": [{"claim": "Mission Shakti has two sub-schemes: 'Sambal' for safety and security of women, and 'Samarthya' for empowerment of women", "evidence_ids": ["E02"]}, {"claim": "Sambal sub-scheme includes One Stop Centre, Women Helpline, BetiBachaoBetiPadhao, and Nari Adalat", "evidence_ids": ["E02"]}, {"claim": "Samarthya sub-scheme includes Ujjwala, SwadharGreh, Working Women Hostel, National Creche Scheme, PMMVY, and Gap Funding for Economic Empowerment", "evidence_ids": ["E02"]}, {"claim": "Mission Shakti objective is to provide services for holistic development and empowerment of women and girls including marginalized groups", "evidence_ids": ["E02"]}]}
